reviews.comment: Overall, this class was an easy A, however, there was a TON of busy work. Attendance was mandatory as some projects were completed in class. She is a great teacher with tons of knowledge and is always willing to share if you go up and talk to her.
Extra credit in class. Exams straight from lecture so go to class for exam units. Projects are time consuming. Lab is fun.
Great teacher and really funny! Kept things interesting and I learned a lot, I genuinely enjoyed the class, just study and do the work and you will be totally fine. Impossible to fail.
I LOVE PAIGE! 311 was my favorite class in the whole world- I even TA's for it. Paige is my favorite and she should have a 5/5 this is blasphemy

Loved Paige but didn't like the class that much. ANSC 211 is just one of those classes you have to take for the credit. Attendance wasn't mandatory, but you had to come to class to do the in-class work. Most of it is career-prep but overall felt like busy work. Some of the projects require a lottt of time (reaching out to faculty to do interviews)

I think she is a great person. The part that gets me is it isn't very informative because it is information you should already know and a TON of busy work that i feel like I got no benefit from. This is the reason I wouldn't take again, I just don't have time for the amount of busy work.

I loved Paige!  She is super casual and fun and makes classes interesting.  Attendance isn't mandatory but when people don't show up she usually does extra credit.  There were 2 exams and 2 projects as exam grades.  It's nice not having a final but there are quite a few projects between class and lab, kinda seems like busy work.

Professor Linne is honestly a great teacher she's funny and engaging but it was so much work for a 2 hour class. So much busy work to make resumes, cover letters, random graphics, grading other people's assignments so she didn't have to, and was i was always busy with her class. Honestly a good class and got good skills but lots and lots of work.

Ms. Linne is one of the best professors I've ever had. She challenges her students to do their best and actually cares that you learn the material. She's accessible outside of class & truly cares about her students' well being. Her lectures are entertaining and informative, and her hands-on knowledge makes her great to learn from. Love her!

Paige is possibly the best professor I've had in my college experience. She is approachable and charismatic, as well as an excellent teacher. She is more than happy to help students outside of schoolwork, and is honest & realistic when giving advice. I highly recommend taking her class, even if it is not required for your degree

Paige is the bomb .com! Had her for 311 and 211 and you won't find a better teacher in the animal science department. Paige is a hoot and I look forward to class every day. Long live ANSC 311 3 pm 2019! WHOOP!
reviews.ratingTags: Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.--Hilarious

reviews.comment: Teaches things everyone already knows about the equine industry if they have common sense or have any experience with it. Basic assignments like making a resume and a few group projects. No tests or quizzes. Attendance is mandatory or she will drop your grade significantly. Wants you to participate in every class by asking questions or commenting.
reviews.ratingTags: Participation matters--Graded by few things--Group projects

reviews.comment: She teaches a horse training class but doesnt ride her own horse. wants to push you past your comfort zone but refuses to move the class at a quick pace. Her methods of training are most likely to differ from your own, very frustrating its her way- no other way is correct. If you forget to clean ur stall 1 day ur grade will DROP. Weekly journals
